faq.q0: What is Astro and why did you choose it for our corporate website?
faq.a0: Astro is a modern web framework. Its biggest advantage is that it ships zero JavaScript by default and outputs plain HTML. That lets us build sites that load extremely fast and are SEO-friendly and accessible.
faq.q1: How does your project development process work?
faq.a1: We start with a discovery call to define your needs. We then send a detailed proposal and, once approved, move on to technical planning and development. We manage the process with regular feedback loops.
faq.q2: How do you integrate AI models?
faq.a2: Depending on your needs we use cloud APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic, or — where data privacy requires it — deploy open-source models on your own servers.
faq.q3: How can we update the content on our website?
faq.a3: The project is Markdown-based. You can change your content instantly by editing simple .md files. No database or complex CMS setup is required.

blog.llm-entegrasyonu-uretime-tasima.tit: LLM Integration: From Idea to Production
blog.llm-entegrasyonu-uretime-tasima.des: The challenges of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into real-world projects, and the practices that work.
blog.llm-entegrasyonu-uretime-tasima.bod:
Large language models work beautifully in a lab setting, but moving them into production is an entirely different engineering effort.

1. Prompt Injection Protection

Before exposing an LLM to end users, you need solid filters against malicious input (prompt injection). Your system prompt must be protected and incoming user data sanitised.

2. Token Limits and Cost Management

API-based services bill piece by piece for every word. If the context grows too large, both latency and cost climb. This is where designing a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture becomes the gold standard.

3. Response Speed (Streaming)

Rather than showing the user a blank screen for ten seconds, the response should stream onto the page as the model produces it.

Overcoming these challenges when building modern AI-powered products comes down to the right architectural decisions. At AKA Software we apply these best practices from day one to deliver secure, fast infrastructure on your projects.
blog.mlops-pratikleri.title: Managing Machine Learning Models: MLOps Practices
blog.mlops-pratikleri.description: If anything is harder than building a model, it is keeping that model alive in production sustainably.
blog.mlops-pratikleri.body:
You trained your model and the metrics look great. What happens next? Once data distributions shift in production, your model starts to go stale (data drift and concept drift).

MLOps is the adaptation of DevOps practices from software engineering to machine learning projects. It means lifting a model out of the "Jupyter notebook" stage into something that can be trained, tested, packaged and served automatically.

Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD)

Putting training code under version control is not enough — the data needs versioning too (using DVC). Jobs connected to your databases should check model quality on a schedule and alert the team when metrics decline.

AKA Software takes the valuable models your data scientists build and puts them into production in full compliance with engineering standards.
blog.ai-stratejisi-90-gun.title: A 90-Day AI Strategy for Your Business
blog.ai-stratejisi-90-gun.description: If you don't know where to start, here is a phased 90-day AI transformation guide for your company.
blog.ai-stratejisi-90-gun.body:
Everyone is talking about AI, yet very few businesses have genuinely turned the technology into a productivity tool. Here is a 90-day action plan:

First 30 Days: Process Discovery

Don't start writing code straight away. Where would automation deliver the most value? Identify the repetitive work — data entry, customer support replies, invoice parsing.

Second 30 Days: Pilot Project (PoC)

Don't try to change every process. Pick the single most pressing one and build a working prototype. An internal question-and-answer tool over your documentation (a RAG system), for example, is a good starting point.

Final 30 Days: Production and Feedback

Roll the model out to a pilot team. Improve it with the data that comes back (fine-tuning and prompt iteration).

You can take this journey with confidence alongside AKA Software. We're ready to be your technology partner at every stage, from strategy through development.

cases.nda-ecommerce-personalization.body:
An online retail brand (under NDA) realised that users were getting lost among hundreds of thousands of products on their site and that they were falling short of their target conversion rates.

The Solution

We built a microservice that runs without touching the existing monolithic infrastructure. We developed a hybrid recommendation system that processes browsing data in real time and filters similar products both semantically (semantic search) and behaviourally.

The Outcome

The brand's marketing team observed that customer loyalty rose considerably once a personalised feed was in place.
cases.nda-fintech-fraud-detection.title: Fraud Prevention Through Anomaly Detection
cases.nda-fintech-fraud-detection.descri: Minimising losses by detecting anomalies in real-time transaction data.
cases.nda-fintech-fraud-detection.highli: 40% reduction in the false positive rate.
A real-time alerting dashboard built for the team.
cases.nda-fintech-fraud-detection.body:
A fast-growing fintech startup (under NDA) saw fraud cases climbing alongside its rising transaction volume. Manual review processes were no longer sustainable.

What We Did

Going beyond classic rule-based systems, we built a supervised machine learning pipeline that analyses patterns in historical transactions. The model began scoring the probability of fraud on each transaction in real time, and only high-scoring, suspicious transactions reached the analysts. To speed up their work we built a fast, modern Astro dashboard.
